_comment: Default copy for the SECOND questionnaire email: the one sent to people whose first
invitation carried a link they could not open.
A separate variant rather than an edit to the normal copy, because both are needed at the
same time. Fifty-one people are owed an apology and a working link; everyone else has heard
nothing from us at all and must not be told we broke something they never saw.
unsubscribe line is appended by the sender and cannot be edited away here. The token in the
link is the SAME one their first email carried, so anyone who kept that email and tries it
later still lands on their own questionnaire.
subject: That link we sent you was broken. Here is one that works.
heading: Our link was broken
subtitle: {{name}}, six questions and about a minute. Working link this time.
body:
Hello {{name}},

A few days ago we emailed to ask how your CBAT went. The link in that email was broken. It pointed at a test computer rather than the website, so if you tapped it, nothing happened at all.

That one is entirely on us, and we are sorry for wasting your time. Here is the same question with a link that actually goes somewhere.

- Six questions, about a minute, and nothing to sign in to.
- Your answers go straight back into the training, so whoever is revising right now gets a better version than you had.
- If you passed, we will record it, and a PASSED badge appears next to your name on every leaderboard.

{{button}}

Not sat it yet? Say so on the first question and we will leave you alone until after your test.

Thanks for bearing with us,
The SkyWatch Team
